title: FROM COINBASE TO DARKNESS
subtitle: WHAT ACTUALLY HAPPENS WHEN YOU SHIELD ZEC.

blocks.text: YOU BOUGHT THE COIN IN PUBLIC. THAT DOES NOT MEAN EVERY PAYMENT AFTERWARD HAS TO LIVE THERE.
START AT THE EXCHANGE.

A centralized exchange knows information about activity inside the account it operates. If it sends ZEC to a transparent Zcash address, the withdrawal also enters the public transaction graph. The recipient transparent address, amount and transaction are visible on-chain.

Many exchanges historically support transparent Zcash withdrawals rather than direct shielded withdrawals. Zodl documents this exact path: withdraw to the wallet's transparent address, then shield the received ZEC before spending it privately.
THE ON-RAMP CAN BE PUBLIC. THE NEXT STATE DOES NOT HAVE TO BE.
01 // THE TRANSPARENT DEPOSIT

When ZEC arrives at a transparent address, that deposit is public. Anyone who knows the address can inspect deposits to it. If the exchange knows the withdrawal destination because you supplied it, the exchange can also associate its own withdrawal record with that destination.
02 // ZODL DETECTS THE BALANCE

Zodl is built around shielded ZEC but can receive transparent deposits for compatibility with exchanges. Its support documentation says that when a transparent balance is detected, the wallet prompts the user to shield it. Zodl requires incoming transparent ZEC to be shielded before it can be spent from the wallet.
03 // PRESS SHIELD

Shielding creates an on-chain transfer from the transparent value pool into a shielded value pool. The amount crossing that pool boundary is public. What changes is the representation of the value after it enters the shielded pool: shielded value is carried by notes whose protected payment details are not published like transparent outputs.
SHIELDING DOES NOT ERASE THE DEPOSIT. IT CHANGES WHAT THE CHAIN CAN SEE NEXT.
04 // INSIDE THE SHIELDED POOL

Once value is shielded, subsequent fully shielded transfers can protect sender and recipient addresses and the transferred amount from public blockchain disclosure. The network still validates the transaction through commitments, nullifiers, signatures and zero-knowledge proofs rather than by exposing an ordinary transparent payment graph.

In 2026, Zcash's shielded-pool landscape includes Ironwood, introduced as a successor pool using the Orchard cryptographic design. The exact pool used by current wallet software can evolve with network upgrades, so the important concept is the boundary between public transparent value and value held and transacted within the active shielded protocol.
05 // WHAT THE EXCHANGE DOES NOT MAGICALLY FORGET

Shielding does not rewrite the exchange's records or remove the earlier transparent withdrawal from the blockchain. If an exchange knew that it sent a particular amount to a particular transparent address, shielding cannot make that historical fact cease to exist.

What shielding can change is the visibility of later shielded activity. The public chain no longer exposes the same direct address-to-address graph for fully shielded payments. That is different from claiming that every possible observer has forgotten where the funds originally came from.
06 // DO NOT TURN THE POOL INTO A TUNNEL

Zodl's own privacy guidance warns against treating shielding as a temporary pass-through. If a distinctive amount is shielded and almost immediately the same distinctive amount is sent back to a transparent destination, the timing and amount pattern can be easy to recognize.

Keeping funds shielded and making ordinary payments from shielded value avoids repeatedly publishing transparent boundaries. Privacy depends not only on the cryptography but also on how the wallet and user interact with those boundaries.
THE SHIELDED POOL IS NOT A LAUNDRY CHUTE. IT IS WHERE PRIVATE MONEY IS MEANT TO LIVE.
ANOTHER PATH // ENTER SHIELDED

A transparent exchange withdrawal is not the only possible on-ramp. Zodl documents swaps from supported external assets directly into shielded ZEC, and some exchanges may support shielded withdrawals. These paths can reduce the need to expose a Zcash transparent receiving address, although the external service or source chain may still possess its own records and metadata.
THE DIFFERENCE IN ONE LINE.
SHIELDING DOES NOT DELETE YOUR PAST. IT CHANGES HOW MUCH OF YOUR FINANCIAL FUTURE HAS TO BE PUBLIC.
